caption: Diagram 1.3 | Minimum headroom
description: This is a section drawing labelled "Diagram 1.3 Minimum headroom" in a green band along the base, with the note "See para 1.11" at the top left. It depicts a stair flight descending between two landings. The upper left horizontal surface is labelled "Landing", the lower right horizontal surface is labelled "Landing", and the stepped portion is labelled "Flight". A dashed diagonal line runs along the step nosings and is labelled "Pitch line". Above the flight, a solid sloping line represents the overhead, with a parallel dashed line just below it. Three vertical dimension arrows, each marked "At least 2m", indicate vertical clearances: the first spans from the left landing up to the horizontal ceiling line above it; the second spans from the pitch line up to the sloping overhead; and the third spans from the right landing up to a horizontal dashed line labelled "Minimum headroom".
